lines.trans: Hello, Viktor Petrovich.
And what do you call this?
What brings you here?
And what is this here in the trash?
After all, I warned you, Vitya.
If you do not stop working like a horse, it will all end with an orchestra.
And mournful music.
Tell me, are you at least taking what I prescribed for you?
Of course, three times a day instead of food.
Did you come to check on me or to monitor me?
Hello, may I steal my dad from you?
Of course, go right ahead.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'pill, tablet' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Принимай таблетки, Витя!
examples.trans: Take your pills, Vitya!

examples.text: Я принял одну таблетку.
examples.trans: I took one pill.

examples.text: Где мои таблетки?
examples.trans: Where are my pills?
